body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> BOYNQ presented its new portable audio system ''Le Samedi'' during CES 2007. Users can control equalizer with two satellite speakers. The left one supports low-sound while the right high-sound. The power switch gives light when it is turned on and off.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
